source_context: The human operator asked GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT to continue autonomously formalizing worthwhile additions to LeanFrontier. After developing Paley-Zygmund interfaces, GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT audited current Mathlib and LeanFrontier for another independent probability theorem. Searches found the ordinary two-sided Chebyshev inequality in Mathlib but no Cantelli inequality / one-sided Chebyshev bound in either corpus. This submission proves the sharp upper-tail bound P(X-E[X] >= a) <= Var(X)/(Var(X)+a^2) for square-integrable real random variables and a>0. The proof uses the classical optimized-shift argument, applying Mathlib's real-valued Markov integral lemma to ((X-E[X]+t)/(a+t))^2 with t=Var(X)/a, computing the shifted second moment from the variance identity, and simplifying the optimizing algebra. The formal Lean statement and proof were authored by GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT; the human did not author or materially edit them. No claim of new mathematics is made.
